quarterly_data.signal: Director and general manager Qiu Oute (results briefing): the company's customers are mainly MLCC and other electronic-component makers and paste makers, including Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Chaozhou Three-Circle, Taiwan's Yageo and Sinocera. It makes ultra-fine powders industrially by atmospheric-pressure plasma heating and vapour condensation, a technology that can be adapted to many metal and non-metal powders, and plans to broaden its product range on this platform. It has filed a patent application (under review) for copper plating of graphite powder surfaces to improve anode-material electrical performance.
